notes: Each case freezes one creation case, one controlled rename/add-case refactor and one diagnostic-repair case per the evaluation protocol.

Candidate (new-mechanism) fixtures are pending by design: later tasks add them under tests/baseline/candidates/<owner-task>-<case>/ and must not edit registered prompts, held-out variants or hidden checks without opening a new dated revision.
The current-idiom baseline gets the same task and test access as every candidate.
A preliminary pilot may debug the harness but is never counted among the five attempts.

escalation.when: both primary and efficient fail a case, or a candidate advantage may instead be a capacity limit

standard.workspace: fresh workspace state per attempt; no access to another attempt's transcript
